Class RouxLayout

java.lang.Object
org.roux.layout.RouxLayout
public final class RouxLayout extends Object
The RouxLayout type holds the foreign-memory layouts used to read a page and an index row. A foreign-memory layout is the Java description of one primitive in off-heap bytes. BYTE reads one byte. SHORT_LE reads a little-endian short. INT_LE reads a little-endian int. LONG_LE reads a little-endian long. A header field and an index field use these same layouts. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxLayout roux-design.md
